name: Latin tamb and cowbell dub
desc: Latin-tinged sibling: triplet-elongation tambourine shuffle, dub-delayed cowbell euclid that rotates, and a polymetric tom conversation (lt/mt/ht cycling over 3-against-8) with degradeBy ghosting. Warmer, more playful than the .01 shaker grid.

code.full: stack(s("[tb@2 tb]*4").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.4, ${gain}).fast(4)), s("cb(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.3).delay(".35:.375:.5"), s("{lt mt ht}%8").gain(".4 .2 .3 .25").degradeBy(.35).lpf(${cut})).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[tb@2 tb]*4").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("cb(5,16,<0 3 6 9>)").gain(.32).delay(".3:.375:.45"), s("{lt mt ht cb}%16").gain(".38 .18 .3 .22").degradeBy(.25).lpf(${cut})).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
